description: This source file provides functions to compute SHA-256 hashes for inline <script> blocks in HTML, to assist in Content Security Policy (CSP) management. It exports utility functions to generate CSP headers with appropriate script hash directives based on inline script contents.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Calculates SHA-256 hashes for each inline <script> block in an HTML string, ignoring scripts with a src attribute.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Generates a CSP header string for controlling script sources, optionally including hashes for inline scripts.
